title: Extended Trailer
body:
"A load more space that you will probably never need! Wait... how did they get it in such a small box?"

The Extended Trailer is a trailer that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $21,250.

Details

The Extended Trailer is an extended version of the Basic Trailer, hence the name. It is even wider than the widest vehicle in the game, the Sellner Explorer. It has an internal volume of 7×3.5×20.5 studs.
